description: A formal residential gate entrance photographed at dusk in a lush subtropical setting. Two substantial square masonry gate pillars in white-painted stucco or cast stone are positioned symmetrically in the foreground, flanking a slim matte-black vertical-bar iron gate. The pillars have a classical profile with a raised cap detail at the top. Dense low evergreen hedges and rounded boxwood or ficus shrubs flank both sides of the pillars at ground level, their deep green tones intensifying in the dim evening light. A tall palm tree with a graceful arching trunk rises at the right mid-ground. In the background, a grand Mediterranean-style residential facade glows warmly: a white stucco house with an arched entry portico featuring a fanlight transom window, fluted pilasters with decorative capitals, a dark mahogany double entry door, and rectangular windows with white trim. The upper arch of the portico is warmly backlit from interior illumination, and the facade surface is washed in a gentle amber uplight from ground-level landscape lighting. The sky is a deep twilight blue. Two warm glowing forms sit atop the gate pillars, their luminous amber-white glow the dominant light source in the foreground, casting gentle upward and downward washes of light across the pillar cap surfaces and the adjacent hedge foliage. Camera is at standing eye-level, shooting a centered symmetrical view down the gate entry axis toward the house facade. Normal lens, capturing the full gate, both pillars, the flanking hedges, and the lit house entrance at middle distance. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
